items.title: Client Spotlight: Milika Tembo Takes the Stage in the UK
items.body: We are proud to celebrate our client, Milika Tembo (PhD Candidate, Kapasa Makasa University).
items.details:
We are proud to celebrate our client, Milika Tembo (PhD Candidate, Kapasa Makasa University), who recently presented her compelling research, "Pilgrims Without Maps: Bibliotherapy Without Construction in Unstructured Contexts," at a major conference in the United Kingdom.   At Growthive Media, we empower high-impact leaders, scholars, and brands to elevate their presence and communicate their vision on global stages.   Congratulations to Milika on this incredible milestone!

visit her website: www.milikatembo.com
